### Public docs

See the public docs at [https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/mctoolsoverview](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/mctoolsoverview) for more.

#### Configuring the HTTP server

Use `mct setserver <domain name> <port>` to ensure that you set up the serving- domain and IP address properly.

<domain name> should probably be the internal IP address of your PC. E.g., in an Azure environment, your external IP might be 10.20.30.2, but the internal IP of the machine might be 10.0.0.6. Try setting domain name to 10.0.0.6.

Other things to try:

- Ensure that port 80 (or whatever port you use) is set to allow in the Windows Firewall. Make sure that your network is on the right Guest (or probably private) network.
- Consider granting access to node through the firewall, by adding c:\program files\nodejs\nodejs.exe

**Good luck, have fun!**
